383	in our physical world.
384	The Rambam says: do you know why there is no description
385	in Judaism of exactly what the Garden of Eden is? It is written that the tzaddikim
386	sit with crowns on their heads, which symbolizes kingship,
387	a kind of release from all the material matters of the world,
388	and enjoy the radiance of the Shechinah. But elaborate more, what is it
389	like, what kind of pleasure is it? The Rambam says: just as
390	you cannot explain to someone blind from birth what
391	color is, so you cannot explain to a person while he is
392	in this world in a way that he will understand what the Garden of Eden is.
393	And our Torah is a Torah of truth, so it does not try
394	to deceive people, it does not try to trick you:
395	listen, keep the mitzvot, and in the Garden of Eden you will eat
396	cakes and have such lusts and such pleasures. That is
397	false, it is not true. Therefore our Torah only says:
398	know that one hour of contentment in the World to Come is better
399	than all the life of

401	the radiance of the Shechinah. The more a person in this world breaks

428	one likes to be in contact with him, and they only flee

433	is between him and his fellow, in marriage, in raising children. Also
434	raising children: children who see an example of parents
435	who speak pleasantly, calmly, respectfully, with derech eretz,
436	these children go out into life and they too have peace in the
437	home. Children who see in their parents an example of tension
